search.name: session.search
search.description: Search prior chat messages and agent thread activity before asking the user to repeat context.

query.description: Search terms to find in prior chat messages and thread activity.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 50.

sessionId.description: Optional chat session ID to restrict message and thread results.

threadId.description: Optional agent thread ID to restrict thread activity results.

includeMessages.description: Whether to search chat messages. Defaults to true.

includeThreadActivities.description: Whether to search agent thread activity. Defaults to true.

traces.name: chat.traces
traces.description: Retrieve the full execution trace of a chat by its session/chat id: persisted messages (with executed tool calls, context flow, and reasoning), plus any agent threads and their activity logs. Use this to inspect how a past chat actually ran — evaluate provider behaviour, diagnose loops, or audit tool usage.

chatId.description: Chat (session) id to fetch traces for.

includeMessages.description: Include chat messages. Defaults to true.

includeThreads.description: Include agent threads + their activities. Defaults to true.

includeToolCalls.description: Include parsed tool-call payloads on assistant messages. Defaults to true.

includeContextFlow.description: Include the full outbound LLM context-flow rounds. Verbose — defaults to false.

includeThinking.description: Include chain-of-thought / reasoning content. Defaults to false.

messageLimit.description: Max messages to return (most recent). Defaults to 200, capped at 1000.

activityLimit.description: Max thread activities per thread. Defaults to 200, capped at 2000.
